title: Getting along with all kinds of people
summary: Greer says people like him and the Cotton Club took time to accept.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: The Cotton Club was a million miles away from us. It took me a long time to get acclimated to working in the Cotton Club. That thing broke my heart, man, much money as I was -- I was a little nephew. Them cats were looking out for me. Man, they had a blanket over top of me. I was making money right and left.
But you always got along with people pretty quickly.
Yeah, well, understand, I like people

and people like me. I don't know what it was, I don't know what it is, even to this day. But people and I always got along, all kinds of people. Because -- I don't know, just maybe they -- I'm a hell of a liar and a good actor.
